verdict.rationale: Better Stack's marketing docs say an engineer can request cover from a colleague with a single click, and that overrides can be created with a single click. Together these cover two of the three self-service actions without an admin rebuilding the schedule. Shift swapping is not explicitly documented, and there are no in-depth docs or hands-on reports. missing for 10: an explicitly documented shift-swap capability, detailed docs on the override and request-cover workflows and their permissions (whether non-admins can do them), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule
